purpose: CASIA evaluator integration verification only; not full benchmark results

fid.rendering: same fixed width for GT and predicted XY; grayscale repeated to RGB; package resize/normalize

protocol.miou: macro mean of whole-character foreground IoU, BOTH rendered at fixed width
protocol.dtw: sum of Euclidean XY costs along exact min-cost path; original point order, no resampling, no pen-up coordinate insertion
protocol.dtw_path_mean: same optimal path cost divided by path length; not PEN-Net LDTW
protocol.fid: dataset-level 2048-D pytorch-fid features, same fixed-width rendering as mIoU
protocol.scope: local 256x256 external evaluation; not a claim of matching any published split/render/sampling protocol
protocol.width: POT has XY and pen-up boundaries, no measured width/pressure/time; diameter is synthetic

summary.inference_timing: CUDA synchronized, excludes model load, warmup, rasterization, transfer, metrics, saving, visualization and FID

limitations: Only first two Chinese samples; no full CASIA benchmark executed
Two-image FID verifies code path only; not a model-quality estimate
Validation artifacts and dependencies reside in /tmp; may be cleared
